label: b1-fixtures-R6
text:
Node fixtures-R6 (7 of 10): write test cases for R6: at least two that break the rule, as files in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R6/flag, and at least two that follow it, in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R6/pass. Each is one file of what the check reads (A source code file. Where: /workspace/<path>, on disk for every mechanism; the content of a write before it happens: only the framework's hook (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/framework-hooks.md) before its write tool Which files: decide when the check runs, from the file in hand: the files the agent will create cannot be known before. Map its name, or its content, to a language with a complete list, such as Pygments (`get_lexer_for_filename`, `guess_lexer`) or GitHub Linguist's list of languages. Code also sits inside other files: a `<script>` or `<style>` in HTML, a notebook cell, a code block in Markdown. A file of an unknown kind is checked, not passed.); make them like what the agent may really write.
Done when: /opt/enforce/fixtures/R6/flag and /opt/enforce/fixtures/R6/pass each hold at least two files. The harness checks this when you reply.
